sentence: tekvwalawitsolheno anikwalihsi v ale khilo iyunhski tinowelihski, tsiluhsilimi nvtayunilohsvhi.
tunikohvnho ikatv kvwhahstawatitohi katu anikihskv tikataha tsunoyeni kvhti, (nahski nitunahsulehvna kathka,) unihsonvtsele'i.
anikwalihsihyeno v ale nani'vkwo anitsuhsi, iyunho' ohstv nitunhsulehvna yiki, vlha yinalihstayvhvhsko'ihi tanikhanhahwateko nuniwehsv ethi unatenhvhi.

ale kanhtohtiyi tvnilohi, iyunho'initunhsulehvna yiki, vlha yvkvnalhstayvhvka i ale utsatha nutale kohuhsti tsunikhanhahwtvhstih nunvnelv i nahski tsulihskwiti tikuhilo'v'i ale tithelito, ale vtsahyi tiktlthanvhi tithlit, ale

nhahkwonho anikwalihs ale tinowhelihski ikvwahthvtvnhe hi'a nikvwawehsele'i; katonho ketsstawatitohi vlha yitanikhanhahwateka ethi unatenhvhi uninhetsv'i, nahski nitunhsulehvnakwo tsanalihstayvhvhska?

tunhetshelvnho hi'a nituwehsele'i v ihsaya yelikwo nuwesv' utolehohsv nihi' itsatlonahsti itsine'ihstihskv'i, hi'a tsinikvnhv tsikowhelaav hi'a nahski yvwi kvkilvkwtihha tunihaneka'lv' tantiha, tsuninawihskini invhiyu nitunvnhahteka ayv nakwatvnhv'i.
ahsenho, ahsekwokwo kvkilvkwohtiha tsitanateyohvhska tanateyohvhskv yvwikwo uninetsvhi.
iyvtvyhenho nitsvne unelhanvhi unhetsvhi, yvwi unhnetsv tikhanhahwtvhsti nitsvneha, nahski tithelito' ale tsulihskwiti tikuhilo'v'i; ale utsatha nutaleha nahskiya ulhoyi tetsilvwhihstaneho'i.
ale hi'a ntuwehsele'i, ohsikwo nitsatvneha tsitsiyo'ihseha unelhanvhi unhetsv'i nahski itsatseli tikhanhahwatvhsti itsihskwanikototiyi.
mohsiyhenho hi'a nuwehse'i, hilvkwotehsti tsatota ale tsatsihv ale, khilo ahski nvtihskehsti utota ale utsi v ahse uyohuhihsti kehsehsti.

nihskini hi'a nitsiweha, iyunho khilo hi'a nikawehsehehsti utota ale utsi, kokwani, (nahski katvkhv, akwalhskolhthanvhi,) nika'v ketsalhstehltohti kehsv ayv kvhstelihskv'i; [nahski ututaletv kehsehsti.]
ale' vtl nhahakwo unelaki kohuhsti witatvnhihsi utot ale utsi yetselihseho'i;
nahski unelhanvhi utseli khanohetv ahsekwo nitsvneho itstihsko nihi itsinetsv'i; ale utsathi iyutaleki nahski iyuhstitani nitsatvneho'i.
nikatvnho yvwi wituyhanvhv, hi'a ntuwehsele'i, skiyathvtahstahsi' nitsi'v'ihv ale itsolhki;
vtlhno kohuhsti yvwihi toytitlv ehi, uyvha, nahski kataha yinuwaneho'i; nahskini nvtayunukotsvhi v nahski kataha nuwaneho yvwi.
khilo tekalihlkehsti uthvkotiyi, nahski wathvkvka.
kalhtsotenho wuyvlhv tutanv'elv yvwi, kvhwstawatitohi kvwahthvtvnhe talhilohstv ukvwalhi.
hiano nituwehsele'i, nahskwohsko nihi nahski ika'i nitsolhkvna iki? lhahsko yitskowhahthiha, nahski kohuhsti toyititlv ehi nahski yuyvhiha yvwi kataha ikvwanhti nikehsvna kehsv'i;
nahski unawhiyi winayvhihvna kesv iyuhsti, uhskwolhiyikwohskini, ale wikalohihstihskvkwo, nahskino kanvkalihskv nika'v alhstayvhti?
hianho nuwehse'i, nahski na yvwihi unukotsvhi nahski kataha nuwaneho yvwi.
hawiniyhenho nvtayutalenhvhi i yvwi unawhiyi, titalehvhska uyo atanhthehti kehsv'hihv atayhonehti kesv'i, utelitv tinhsihti kesv'i, atahihsti kehsv'i,

kanohskitv kesv'i, tsukvwalhti' akhvvhihsti kehsv'i, uyo iyatvneti kehsv'i, kalonuhetv kehsv'i, alhsotlv'ihstohti kehsv'i, atvyhuketi kehsv'i, atahsotlvihstohtiyi, atlvkwtohtiyi, alhskanhahwihsti kehsv'i.
hi'a nahski nikatv uyo'i' hawin titalehvhsko'i, ale kataha nuwaneho yvwi.
nanhhanho tulenhv, thaya ale satoni ahstv wuluhtse'i, ale atanelv wuyvlhv', vlha yutulihske khilo utolehohihstiyi; ahseno' vlha kvwatihskalhti yikehse'i.
khilohyeno iyuhsti akeyhv nahski uwetsi athvnutsa kataha atanhto' uya'i, uthvkanv atsinohehskvi, uluhtse ale tulahskv utanvne'i:
(nahski na akeyhv ako'i kese'i, ahsalokwinihsi kehse'i;) ale nahski uhstiyethane nahski uwetsi atvnutsa ahskina unukowhisehtiyi.
ahsenho tsihsa hia nuwehsele'i, ikvyi tiniyolhi witanolhvhi v vtlayeno ohsiyu yiki, tiniyolhi tsunatseli katu tiki'ehtiyi, ale kilhi witatinehtiyi.
nahskino unhetse hi'a nuwehsele'ivv utohiyuhi, tsakvwiyuhiav ahsenho kilhi kahskilv hawinititlv tiniyolhi uninvkohihselvhi katu analhstayvhtihsko'i.
hianho nuwehsele'i, nahski' hi'a tsiniwi winikalhstohta, tsihena; ahskina tsetsiyi aya'v unukoki.
nahskino tsuwenvhsv wi'uluhtsv, utolehohse ahskina unukotsv'i, uwetsinho atsehstokihi kanvhkv'i.
ale thaline thaya ale hsatoni ahstv unhikihsv kelili' vtalv wuluhtse'i, ayelhi ulohse ahskohi-tikatukiyi skatuki kehsv'i.
ikvwahthinohelenho khilo tsuli'ena, ale kanila kawo'nihski; ale ikvwhstiyethane nahski uhsihthatihstiyi.
iyvhtvn wuthinhvhsthanv utayelilv unitsathi anetohv'i, tekayehsatv tikaleni tuhsona'te'i, ale tulitsihskwe'i, ale kanhko uhsvnhile'i;
kalvlatin witukhanhahnv uliyethane'ivi ale hi'a nuwehsele'i, ekweta, nahski katkvh halhstu'i.
kilakwono iyvtv tikaleni tulhstu'ise'i, ale kanhko ulhvhstanelvhi tulikhaneyhvhe, ale ohstv uwonihse'i.
tunvhstatelenho khilo uninonhehtiyi; ahsenho tekanvhstatihsi utlikwo ika'i taniyelihihstihske'i;
al ulohsvhsthanvhi unihskwanikohse'ihsi hi'a naniwehske'i, nikatv ohsiyu teulvwhihstasi; unathvkotiyi nitekvne tsunili'ena, tsunvkhewinho uniwonihihstiyi.
unatotakwahskvnho ulohsonhv, meli makiteli ehi, ale meli tsihmi utsi' aleh salomi uniwhahsvhi kese ukanahstv kawhsvki, uniluhihstiyi uniyelvhse ale kvwalonetiyi.
sunaleiyunho ikvyiyi ika hsunatotakwahsti kehsv'i, uniluhtse atselihstv tsvtikhalvkokwo.
hi'ano nitunatawehsele'i, kako takihv'eli nvya atselihstv' kalohstiy ahv'i?
witunakhanhahanhvno unikohe nvya ahvtv kesv'i, utsathiyeno ekwohiyu kehse'i.
wuniyvlhvnho atselihstv'i, unikohe awiyv akhthihsititlv uwolhe'i v unhuwe kanvhitv unekv anhuwo; anihska'ihenho.
hano nituwehsele'i, lhehsti yitsihska'ihehsti; tsihsa nahseliti' ehi etsiyohahi nahski tsakatv'vhskvki; tulehihsanhv; vlha anhi yika'nv; titsakhanhvka a uninvnv'i.
ahsenho tsitsenaav ale wititsinohvhsi kvwhstawatitohi ale kwita nahski ikvyi witulohihsehtiyi kelili; nanhhtayetsiki, nskiy nitswehslvi. ni-tsi-we-se-lv-i.
ulhihstinho uninukotsv tunalithehse atselihstv'i; tuninawihskeyhenho ale unihskwanikohske'i; vlha ale khilo kohuhsti yunohsele'i; anihska'iheyhenho.
tsihsano tulehihsanv hsunaleiyu ikvyiyi ika hsunatotakwahsti kehsv'i, ikvyi khnikesv nutvnhele meli makiteli' ehi, nahski kalhkwoki anihskina tsitunkowhihsele'i.
nahskino uwenv unetolvhi witunonhele uyo tunatanhthv'i ale tanatloyhihv'i.
nahskinho unathvkanv kvnhv'i, ale nahski ukohvhi, vlha yunohiyunhe'i.
onhino nvwatale nuhste khvnikehsv nitutvnhele anithali nanhhanl anhisi, ttikalohksv' wanikathei. wa-ni-ga-te-i.
nahskino unenv wituninhonele anihso'i; nahskwo' vlha' yitunohiyunhe nahski.

onhinho kvnkehsv nitutvnhele hsatu iyanitv analhstayvhvhskvihi ale tukvhskolvne nikalhstohtihske nunohyuhsvna kehsv ale tihstayiyu kehsv tsuninawhi, ntunohiyuhnvna kehsv iyuhsti nahski kvwakohvhi tsulehsanhi nikehse'i.
hianho nituwehsele'i, itsetna elohi nikvnathv'i, ale wititsalhtsitohvhsi ohstv khanohetv nani'v kekolhvnhvhi.
khilo kohiyuhvhskehsti ale akawohskehsti atsihstelhti kehsehsti; nikohiyuhskvnahskini tsakukotanehti kehsehsti.
hi'an nhski uyelhtv tikolhihstohti tha'li tuttitekehsti anohyuhvhski; ayv takwato anhtihskehsti anihskina taninukowhihskehsti v nvwanatale tsuniwonihihsti taniwonihskehsti;
inatv taninheskehsti v iyu ale kohuhsti atahihi yunatithahv, vlha kohuhsti yunvnehehsti; tsunitlvki tanahsihthatihskehsti, ale tunatiwhskehsti.
nahskinho ukvwiyuhi tuwonhthanv i kalvlati totsatetanilvtse'i, ale akhthihsi ititlv unelhanvhi uwolhv uwenhe'i.
unenhvhsenho ale nikvnathv unahltsitonhitole'i, ukvwiyuhi thali utvhtiteke tunilvwhihstanehv'i, ale aninhekv ahstaytihstske uyelhthv ullhoyahstitehkv'i. emenv.
tsihsanho utenhv katuyi katuhv tsutiyi v nahiyu tsehe elotv ukvwiyuhi, khvhnhiyukwo uniluhtse tsiluhsilimi anikhthanhahi nvto tikhalvkv ititlv tsunilohse'i,
hi'a nuniwehse'i v hatlv na tsutenhv ukvwiyhi anitsuhsi unatselika, okikohvyhenho utseli nokwihsi tikhalvkv ititlv, ale otsatatolihstanelika.
elotno ukvwiyuhi uthvkanv' nahskiav uwelihihsti utanvhtate'i, ale nikatv tsiluhsilmi anehi.
tulawithvnho nikatv nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv anelhohi v ale yvwi tinowhelanehi, tuthvtvnhe'ivi nanhhutt kehsv kalntv. Ga-lo-ne-dv.
hi'anho nikvwawehsele'i; tsutiyi katuy katuhv'i; hiayhenho nuwanhv uwowhela atolehohski;
ale nihi katuyi katuhv tsutiyi, vlhahskini tsahstikhani yiki, tsilotahsuya nunikvwiyuhsv tsutiyi, nihiyhenho tatsanukotsi tikwatseli yvwi ihsili-tikhanetsehi.
nhahkwono elotv utelitv wituyhanvhv nahski anikhthanhahi, ohstv tuthvthihsahne' iyukwo nahski nokwsi unanukotsv'i.
ale tunvhse katuyi, hi'a nuwese'i i itsena ohstv wetsiyoka nahski uhsti ayolhi, iyunho etsiwahthvhvha, ihskinonhelilhvha, ayvnho nahskwo witsiluhtsvha, ale tsiyatatolihstanelvha.
unathvkanhonhelvnho ukvwiyuhi unanhikihse'i, kvnhiyukwonho nokwsihv nahski' unikohvhi tikhalvkv' ititlv, ikvyi unenv'ele'i v khvnhi wuluhtsilhv ale ulewhihsthanv kalvlatitlv nnhahatsli hi. e-hv-i.
unikohvnho nahski nokwsi, ulothanvhi unalihelitse'i.

atanelvnho uniyvlhv unikohe ayolha ale utsi meli i ale elati tunatanvne'i, unatatolihstanele'ihi ale tsukvwalhohti unihlanvtv tunihstu'ihsv uninhelvne nvnalhskolhthanvhi, atelv-talonitv, ale ukanahstv kawhsvki atlat ale mila.
anahskitskvhno unelanvhi tunetselv elotvyi wunilohihstiyi nikehsvna, unanhikihsv utsathinikwo ititlv wunilohse iunenv unatselikohi.

unanhikihsvnho khvnhiyukwo tikhanhahwtitohi unvhsitv yihowa khvnikehsv nutvnhele tsowa ahskitskv'i, hia nuwehsele'i; thalehvkaav ale thathinhuka ayolhi ale utsi' ale halithi, itsikwi whilohi, nanhhanho whehehsti khvni wikvnetselvhahi elotvhyenho ahse tvyholi uhsti ayolhi uhihstiyi.
nhahkwono tulenhv uthinhvhse ayolhi' ale utsi' svnoyihi ale itsitvyi wulohse'i.
ale nanhahwh kvhni hlotv uyohsv; utohihyne hunehlanvhi unetsvi, atlhoski' tsuwvthahni, hiha' tsnwesi; itsikwihyi' witsiynvhv akwetsihv a-que-tsi.

nhahkwono elotv utolehohsv anikhthanhahi kvwalitahsthanv'i i utsahthanvhi uthalhawohse'i v ale utanvhse witunihonhe nikatv tiniyolhi katuyi anehi, ale nikatv nkvnatv nanhahani, tha'li iyunatethiyvtv wahsthi, nahiyu nvtayutalenvtv tsitalhsinhihstanehe tsitathvtvhelhv'vhske anikhthanhahi.
nhahkwonho utohiyunhe tselimay atolehohski unhetsvhi, hale tsinuwehse'i;

lemayi khanekv unathvkanvkiav taniyvhkv'iki ale tanatloyhihv'i, ale utsathi unelhuhkv'ivi letsili tahskonhihv tsuwetsi v ale nutulihskvna kehsv' unhuwohistiyi, nvtikalihstohtihskv nanehvnakwo kehsv'i.
nhahkwonho elotv uyohuhsv, khvniyukwo tikhanhahwatitohi yihowa utselika khvnikehsv nutvnhele tsowa ahskitskv' itsikwiyi,
hi'a nuwehsele'i; thalehvka ale hathinhuka ayolhi ale utsi, ale hena ihsiliyi, nhahakwohyenho tuniyohuhsv ayolhi kvnhv tsuniyohvki.
tulenhvnho uthinhvhse ayolhi ale utsi, ale ihsiliyi wuluhtse'i.
ahsenho uthvkanv atsila ukvwiyuhi kehsv tsutiyi utota elotv utanetliyvhstanelv'i v uhskale nanhahwlhsty; asehno' uhnlanhi uweythanvhi kehsv askihtski, kelili wkolvsthni; wu-go-lv-s-ta-ne-i;
katuhvnho nahselithi tsuto'itv wuluhtsv nanhahehe'i. nskno tohyune antohlehoshki tsuninehtsei, naseliti ehi akshsti, tsuhnahtvhni. tsu-na-dv-ne-i.
tsiyuhinho utsanv, tuwehsohtse'i, uwahsvnho uwetuhv wuluhtse'i.

kvnhiyukwonho kvwahthinhohele ahskaya utlvki ulvtalv'vhski kanhke atsehstokihi; tsihsano utolehohsv anohiyuhvhskv'i, hi'a nuwehsele ulvtalv'vhski; akwetsi, ukalhstiyukwo hatanhthata, tsahskanvtsv etsatoliki.
kvniyukwnho ikatv tinowhelihski' hi'a nuniwehse tunatanhthv'i; hi'a ahskaya kalvlati' ehi ahsotlv'ihstiha.
tsihsanho akhthahe' nuhstv anatanhthehskv'i, hianho nituwehsele'i i katonho uyo itsatanhtheha titsinawhiyi?
katokhe uhsti utli ahitiyu khane'ihstiyi, tsiko hi'a yinakawe'a, tsahskanvtsv etsatoliki? hi'ake yinakawe'a, thalehvka ale hketa?
atina itsatolehohihstiyi yvwi uwetsi ahskanvtsv kvwatatolihsti kesv anhi' elohi, nhahkwo hi'a nuwehsele' ulvtalv'vhski; thalehvka, tsatsehsto hinaki, ale titsenvhsv hena.
tulenhvnho tsuwenvhsv wulohse'i.
unitsathinho unikohv, unihskwankohse'i, ale unilvkwthane unelhanvhi naski tsu'lhihskolhtanelvhi nahski iyuhsti tsunilvwhihstanetiyi yvwi.
tsihsano nnhhutnvs, uko'hvhki askaya matu tstoitv, uwolvki ayelhi akyvthyi. hano nuweselvki; skistahwatuka. tuhlenvno stawatshki. u-s-da-wa-dv-sv-gi.
hiano nulhsthanvki, kanvkv [alihstayvhvhskv] kalhtsote, kvniyukwo unitsathvki atelv anikihsitohi ale anihskana uniluhtsv unanhtlvnvki aninvhtlhta'v tsihsa ale kvwhstawatitohi.
anikwalihsino unatolehohsv, hi'a ntu niwehselv kvwhstawatitohi; katonho' titseyohvhski atelv anikihsitohi ale anihskana itsulaha ianalihstayvhvhska?
tsihsanho uthvkanv hi'a ntuwehselvki; nitunitlvkvna vlha utulhti yinunalhstaneho titanhvwihski, tsunitlvkihskini.

itsenahskini, witsatelhohkwa' katvkv hi'a nahski tsinikaweha; atatolihsti kehsv akwatuliha, vlhanho atsilv-kelhstiyinakesv'i. vtlayhenho nanihskanhvna yititsiyanvhilv, anihskanahskini tsuninetliyvhstiyi tunatanhthv'i.
nhahkwonho tsani kvhwstawatitohi [tsihsa] kvwaluhtselvki, hi'a nikvwawehselvki; katonho ayv anikwalihsino yano amalhi tsotsvhska, nihnho ketsstawatitohi amalhi nanvhskvna tsiki?

tsihsano hi'a ntuwehselvkihi tsiko yeli tekekatsvhstihskv anikhthahi yitanatloyhka ahsikwo utehsvnhilhvhi unhelatitohv'i? ahsenho ika tvlhiyilolhi taketsiyanveli utehsvnhilhvhi, khila nhahkwo amalhi tvnvnhi.
vlha ale khilo itse' yikahlstlvtihsko' uwethi anhuwokihi, kalstlvtvhyeno yvkatsakalvta anhuwo, utatsakalvhvnho utli ekwohiyu yinikalhsta.

vlha ale itse kikake-atithahsti tsuwethi tihsutlvhtv yitanitlihstihsko'i; tihsutlvhtvyheno yitatatsakalv, ale kikake-atithahsti yatsewoki, tihsutlvhthvno yhitayoki. itsehskini kikake-atithahsti titse tihsulhvhtv tanitlihstihsko'i, itsulanho tunihskwanikoto'i.

ahsikwo nahski nitekawehsehvki, kvniykwo khilo iyuhsti nukvwiyuhsateki uluhtsv utatolihstanelvki, hi'a nuwehsvki; akwetsi akeyhutsa kayula uyohuhsitena v atina hena, hiyahsvnhilvha, aha tvatvnhitikwo.
tsihsanho tulenhv uhstawatvhsvki a ale nahskwo kvwhstawatitohi.
kvniyukwonho akeyhv utlvki kikv uwenvehi thalatu tsutethiyvta ikvwalhsthanvhi i onhititlv uluhihstanelvki v kataluyatv unhuwa'v uhsvnhelvki.
hiayheno nuwehse utanhthv'iav iyunho unhuwa'vkwo yakwsvnhilv, ahse yakwatiwhi.
tsihsanho ukhthahvsv ale ukohv, hia nuwehsvki; akwetsi, ukalhstikwo hatanhthata. tsohiyuhsv tsatiwhihsta i akeyhvnho nahiyukwo utiwhsvki.
tsihsanho nukvwiyuhsateki kanelv uluhtsv, ale tukohv tinitselhuhihski, ale yvwi taniyhkv'i,
hi'a ntuwehselvki; itsatanvna, nakonho uyohuhsvhi yiki akeyhutsa; kalhihakwohskini. vkvwayetssthanvkwonho.
ketsinukowhsvnho' yvwi, uyvlhvki' uwoyeni uniyvhvki, akeyhutsano tulenhvki.
nahskino hi'a tunotsalhohtsitolv'i nanhahnknt tyelisithlvk. du-ye-li-si-do-lv-gi.
tsihsanho nanhahtns, anihthli tinikewi anishkaya kvwahstawatsk, unelu'kvki hiha nhniwskki, skinitohliki nihi tehwi uwets. U-we-tsi.
kalhtsoteno uyvlhvhi tinikhewi kvwaluhtselvki, tsihsanho hi'a nituwehselvki; ihstohiyuhvhskahsko yeli nahski ikvkwatvntikikehsv'i? hi'a nikvwawehselvki; vv, tsakvwiyuhi.
nhahkwono tuhsvnhelv tinikhtholi, hi'a nuwehsvki; nuhstv' ihstohiyuhvhskv nahskiya nihstalihstahsi.
tinikhtholinho tulhstukhsvki. htsihsano tunvhstatelvki, hi'a ntuwehselvki; tlehsti khilo utolehohsvki.
ahsenho unatanvhsvkwo tuninotsalhanvki nanhhnknti. ni-gv-na-dv-i.
nhahkwono aninukokv'i kvniyukwo khilo kvwhahthinohelvki' ahskaya uwakhewi, ahskina uya'i.
ahskinanho atsinukowhsv uwakhewi uwonisvki. unitsathinho unihskwanikohsvki, hi'a nuniwehsvki; vlha ilvhiyu nahski iyuhsti akohvhi yiki' ihsiliyi.
ahsenho anikwalihsi hi'a nuniwehsvki; anihskina unatseli ukvwiyuhi kvhtiha tsitekanukowhihska anihskina.

tsihsanho nika'v tsuthvna tekatuhv ale tsusti tekatuhv uwetolvki, tateyhohvhskvki tsunilawihstiyi, ale alhtsitohvhskvki ohstv khanohetv kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv khanohehskvki, ale' tekhanvwihskv nika'v tunitlvkv ale nika'v vyhuki yvwi unihyi'litehv'i.
tukhvn untsth yvwi, twetolitsvki, utakalhstohtihskvki wanakwo tanilokv'i, ale unatikaleyotsvhi kesv'iav nahskiya awhi uninotena nehvna tsikehso unikhthiya.
nhahkwo hi'a ntuwehalv kvwhstawatitohi; ekwohiyu tlokehsi ukhthvnatsvhi, ahsenho anikayolhiyu tsunilvwhihstanehi.
nahski iyuhsti etsithayohsi uloketv tsunvhstiyi' tsunilvwhihstanehi ukahthvnatselvhi.
kalvlatihyenho utselikohi nahskiyakwo ahskaya kanela, sunale'iyu tsuwenvhse tsitunvhsvhse kohuhsti anatvnehi hthehlvlati tuwhihsv tsunilvwhihstanhtiyi.
nhahkwonho nahski' ahskaya kohuhsti anatvnehi tunukhthanv akihsi tsukvwalhti tsukuyv'ehtiyi hsika, thelvlati totsuwhihsv' tunvhse'i.
uwenvhsehno' sonheline iyulhilotv khalawatihsv'i, ale tukohe nvwanatale kanhtohtiyi anitona'e kohuhsti nanatvhvna,
ale hi'a nituwehsele'i; itsena nahskwo nihi thelvlati totiwhihsv'i, tuyuktvnho kehsv tatsvyakuyveli. unenvhsenho.
thaline ika iuwenvhse ale nhskwo tso'ine iyulhilotv khalawatihsv uhsvhiyeyi, nahskiya niutvnele'i.
hihskinenho iyulhilotv khalawatihsv tha'line i'uwenvhse'i, ale tuwhahthvhe nvwanatale anitona'e kohuhsti nanatvnehvna, hianho nituwehsele'i; katonho anhi itsitona utotakwatv kohuhsti nitsatvnehvna?
tlayhenha khilo yokinvhsv, unatvnhe'i. hi'anho nituwehsele'i; nihi nahskwo itsena thelvlti totiwhihsv'i; tuyuktvnho kehsv tatsvyakuyv'eli.

uhsvnho nulhsthanv, thelvlati tawhihsv utselika hia nuwehsele atelv ukhthitehi, withihyanv kohuhsti anatvnehi ale thakuyvhsi tunilvwhihstanelv'i, onhiyhi ketsinvhsvhi thalenhta ikvyiyinho ketsinvhsvhi thihskwalta
hihskineno iyulhilotv khalawatihsv ketsinvhsvhi uniluhtsv, anihsiyvwiha akihsi tsukvwalhti kekakuyv'ele'i.
ikvyiyinho ketsinvhsvhi uniluhtsv utli' iki tayokakuyv'eli unelihse'i. ahsenho nahskwo akihsikwo tsukvwalhti anihsiyvwiha' ikkkuyv'ele'i.
kekakuyvelvhnohi unikonelohihselekwo ahskaya kanela,
hi'a nuniwehse'i; hi'a onhiyi uniluhtsvhi sakwokwo iyulhilotv tunilvwhihstahsi, itsulahakwonho' nvhskiyvka ayv' nahski kakehsv ale utilhehkv ika tsokilvwhihstanelvhi.
ahsenho ahshiyvwi unhetsele hi'a nuwehsele'i; kinali'i, vlha utsathini yinikvyvneha. lhahsko ohsi yitsayelvnhe akihsi tsukvwalhti kvyakuyv'ehtiyi?
hiki tstselika ale tsihena v ohsi akiyelv tsiyakuyv'ehtiyi hi'a onhiyi uluhtsvhi nihi kvyakuyv'elv ika'i.
lhahsko tuyukhthv yiki nuhstv' katanvhthehskv iyakwvnhtiyi akwatseli'ikehsv'ivi tsihsa hikhtholi uyo'iyu iki nvtikalhstohti' ayv akwatanhthiyu ksvi?
howanho onhiyi tsiki ikvyi kehsehsti, ikvyinho tsiki onhiyi kehsehsti. unitsahthayheno ketsiyanvhv, ahsenho anikayolhiyu kekhsuyehsv.
tsihsanho tsiluhsilimi wakhthv'i, tha'latu iyanitv anatahstawatitohi unanelaki iyvtv wituthinhvhsthanvki, ale hi'a nituwehselvki;
kvnhiyukwo tsiluhsilimi witikathi v ale yvwi uwetsi ttaytsysi totaketsoyohihseli nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv-anelhohi ale tinowhelihski, nahskino totvnukhlani uyohuhihstiyi,
ale kunasilenhvtv yvwi totvniyohihseli uniwelhvnanhtiyi, ale unili'vnhstiyi, ale unatvtiyi tsutanhahwatv kethv'i; ale tso'ine ika totv'alenhi.
nhahkwonho uluhtslvki tsekwithi tsuwetsi unitsi, tahthinhehvki tsuwetsi aniwinv i elati utanvnvki, ale ahuhsti uthayosehvki.
hiano nuwhselvki; kato tsatuliha? hi'a nvtayuwehselvki; halhskolhvhta hia anithali tikwetsi tsunihtiyi tsatselikohi kesv'i v sakwo hikhthisi ititlv, so'inho hikhskani.
tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nuwehsvki; lha yihthsi kahthha nuhstv' tsthyohihvi. tsko yelihkwo ketstihthsti ulihskwti' atlstv ayv tstkatihthhi, alesko yelikwo yitetshwst ay naski tstyvkwwosthni? yelikwo,

hiano ntuwehselvki; utohiyuhi akwatseli ulihskwt atlihstv tatsatithahiyv ale ay vkwawohstohti kesv totayetsawohsthani. tsikathihsihskini ale tsikahskani khilo uwehtiyi vlha ayv akwatanhehti yiki, ketsinehtihskininonv kehsehsti nahski etota tsutanelhanlvhi.
ahskohinho iyanitv unathvkanv utsathi unithalhawosvki tuninikwathilhv anithali tinatanhvlhi.
tsihsanho wituyhanvhv hia nuwhsvki v itsikhthaha ayelhi tekolhvwatihsv hnunikvwiyuhsateki aninheko iyunatvnelitahstiyi yvwi v ale ketsilvkwoti aninhetsitohv nanatvneho'i.
nihihskini lhehsti nahski yinitsvhnehstivi khilohskini atsilvkwoti iyulhstohtiyi utulihskehsti nahski etsinvhsitahsti kehsehsti.
ale khilo ukvwiyuhi iyulhstohtiyi utulihskehsti nahski etsinalha'i kehsehsti.
nahskiyakwo yvwi uwetsi utanvhsitahstiyi nuyholhilhvna tsiki, atsinvhsitahstiyikwohskini, ale kvnhv'i ulhskohltohtiy unitsathi tikhyvhtohti.
tselikonho unhnikihsv unitsathi yvwi kvwhahstawatvhsvki.
kvnhiyukwonho anithali tinikewi unohuhlti tunolhvki, unahthvkanvno tsihsa ulohsv'i unelhunhvkiav hi'a nuniwehsvki; skinitoliki, tsakvwiyuhi tewi uwetsi.
unitsathinho tuninhetselvki elhaweyi unhvhtiyi. ahsenho utlikwo ika'i unelhunhvki, hi'a nuniwehsvki, skinitoliki, tsakvwiyuhi tewi uwetsi.
tsihsano ulewhihsthanv wituyhanvhvki i ale hi'a nituwehselvki; kato ihstatuli ayv ihstvyatvnhehtiyi?
hi'a nuniwehsvki: tsakvwiyuhi, tsohstikhtholi tsulhstu'ihstiyi okinatuliha.
tsihsanho tuwetolitsv tiniktholi tuhsvnelvkiai khilakwonho iyvtv kvwanikowahthvhti' nulhsthanvki; ale kvwahstawatvhsvki.
unatotakwonhvhino, khila ika nikalhstihskei alenihskvh suntotakwahsti kehsv meli makiteli ehi aleh so'i meli unakhthanhilhe atselihstv'i.
ale kvnhiyukwo utsathi katohi ulhthelvnhe'i, yihowayhenho utseli tikhanhahwatitohi kalvlati tsutlo'ahse'iyv uluhtsvnho nvya uwehsakwalelhe' uhvhse kalohihstiyi ahv'i; hale uhskilhane'i.
tikhanhtiyi ankalihski nahskiya kese'i, unhuwa'vno vnhtsi tsinunekiyv nunekiye'i.
anikhthiyanho anihskaihv tuninawe'i v ale tsuniyohuhsvhi nahskiya nunalhsthane'i.
tikhanhahwatitohinho unhetsv hi'a nituwehsel anikeyhv; lhehsti nihi yihstihska'ihehsti, tsikahthahyhenho tsihsa akatvnvhi ehstiyohv'i.
vlha anhi thika'na, tulenhvyhenho nahskiya nuwehsv'i v ehstena ehstakhtha ukvwiyhi atsinvnv'i.
ale ulhihstiyu ihstena witihstinohvhsi kvwahstawatitohi te'ulenhv uyohuhsvhi; ale kvnhiyukwo ikvyi kelili nvtayehsi, nanhhtytski. kvniyukwo' hstvnohvsi. i-s-dv-no-hv-si.
ulhihstiyunho atselihstv unata'nvse'i v anihska'ihe ale utsathi analihelike'ihv ale tunihskwalhthane kvwhstawatitohi tuninhonelvhse'i.
ana'ihsvnho taninonelihsv kvwhstawatitohi kvnhyukwo tsihsa tunatlohse'i; thohiyi tetatakowahthv, utvnhe'i. uniluhtsvno tsulahsihteni tuniniyvhe'i, elati nikvwatvnhele'i.
nhahkwonho tsihsa hi'a nituwehsele'i, lhehsti yihstihska'ihehsti a ihstena witihstinohvhsi' otsalinhvlhi kelili wunilohihstiyi, nanhahnho takvkikohi.
anaihsvnho khvniyukwo ikatv uniyawihsvhi uniluhtse katuhv'i, ale nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv-anelhohi tuninhonhele nikatv nulhsthanitolv'i.
nahskinho ale tinilawiki tunilawitsv ale uninohelhv, utsathi atelv tuninhele aniyahwski,
hi'a nuniwehse'i; hi'a nitsiwehsvha; kvwhstawatitohi hsvnoyi uniluhtsvki, otsilhinv kvwanohskihsvki.
iyunho nahski athvkanv ukvwiyuhi, tayotsihstiyethani, ale tatsvhstelvhi.
tunikihsvnho atelv, niketsiwehselv nunatvnele'i. nahskino hia khanohetv ahsi aninhohelhitoha anitsuhsi.
nhahkwonho hsa'tu iyanitv kvwhstawatitohi kelili unenvhsvki tsotalv tsihsa unahsehelv'i.
kvwakohvnho elati nikvwatvnhelvki. ahsenho ikatv unatlahtsithvelvkwo.
tsihsanho uluhtsv tuwonhthanvkisi hi'a nuwehsvki; vkhinelv nika'v tikilvwhihstanhtiy kalvlati ale elohi.
nahski iyuhsti itsena wititseyohvhk nakatv nunatalehsv yvwi, tetsawohskehsti itstihskehsti tuto'v akayvlike'i ale uwetsi ale kalvkwtiyu atanhto,
tetseyohvhskehsti tsunikhanhahwtvhstiyi nika'v itsvnetselv'i; kvniyukwonho nikohilv itsvyelatitoha wikvlhskwatihski elohi. emenv.
